review.reviewer: Independent standard-library recurrence matches pinned source stdout; source repository commit and file hash frozen

title: QuagMirror draft: replay of its first six runes
question: What does the pinned QuagMirror script actually produce before its debug stop?
summary: The pinned script reaches six LP2-00 runes and produces DCBWJO. Its unfinished code stops there; no page reading is demonstrated.

scope.representation: Archived LP2-00 first six runes as zero-based GP indices; nine 29-entry substitution tables from the pinned draft script.
scope.procedure: Recalculate the source autokey and Möbius-driven table selection for its six executed positions, including the two explicit startup overrides; compare intermediate and final streams with the source stdout.
scope.parameters: Pinned source commit 88ef1e60; first six cipher indices 15,8,18,3,6,19; first-position and second-position overrides retained.
scope.exclusions: All positions beyond six, alternative repository drafts, thematic key search, full-page plaintext or English-score controls.

finding: Independent replay agrees with the script: autokey indices 15,28,2,10,3,14 and output indices 23,5,17,7,11,3 transliterate to DCBWJO. The source has an explicit break after six positions.
limitations: The public repository contains multiple changing variants. This record covers only the pinned file and its six-position debug prefix. DCBWJO is not a coherent plaintext and no complete output is present.
next_steps: Freeze one complete variant, remove the debug stop only with specified state behavior, then test full output and a held-out page without reselecting rule transitions.
